description: The depth of ordered DPLL search is at most the length of its supplied atom list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.depth_bound.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (L : List α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.searchDepth L Γ ≤ L.length
